#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

int main() {
    int len;
    std::cin >> len;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    int maxLength = 0;
    int parenthesisWordCount = 0;
    bool insideParenthesis = false;
    bool lastWasLetterFlag = false;
    int currentWordLength = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            insideParenthesis = true;
            lastWasLetterFlag = false;
            currentWordLength = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            insideParenthesis = false;
            lastWasLetterFlag = false;
            currentWordLength = 0;
        } else if (std::isalpha(c)) {
            if (insideParenthesis && !lastWasLetterFlag) {
                parenthesisWordCount++;
            } else if (!insideParenthesis) {
                currentWordLength++;
                if (currentWordLength > maxLength) {
                    maxLength = currentWordLength;
                }
            }
            lastWasLetterFlag = true;
        } else {
            lastWasLetterFlag = false;
            currentWordLength = 0;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxLength << " " << parenthesisWordCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
